description: Compare two STEP files. Returns geometry deltas and parsed document facts: schema, product names/count, assembly flag, authoring system, and organization. These are file-level facts; they do not explain design intent.

file_path_a.description: Path to the first (baseline/original) STEP file. Example: "v1_bracket.step".

file_path_b.description: Path to the second (modified/new) STEP file. Example: "v2_bracket.step".

name: diff
title: Compare Step Versions
